scope: 13 new blouse subcategory campaign photographs; retained existing bespoke Denim and six top-level campaign photographs. Dresses and Club Dresses videos preserved.
artDirection: Warm limestone and plaster settings, natural editorial fashion photography, adult models, each blouse category clearly represented. Horizontal 16:9 composition with subject on the right and photographic negative space to the left. No baked-in text, UI or mist. The separate CSS atmosphere supports later replacement of stills with video.
